title: Distributionally Robust Stochastic MPC under Disturbance-Affine Feedback Policies
summary: This study addresses the stochastic Model Predictive Control (MPC) problem for linear time-invariant systems subjected to unknown disturbance distributions. By leveraging the most recent disturbance data, we construct a set of distributions with similar statistical properties contained within a Wasserstein ball, thereby accounting for the worst-case impacts on constraint satisfaction. Numerous MPC strategies, particularly tube-based approaches, have been extensively studied under the Wasserstein ambiguity set, but these methods often introduce conservatism and can limit control performance.…
